title: 在swoole_websocket_server start回调启动的swoole_process中无法向客户端push消息?
author: kings36503

comments.body: 使用`addProcess`，不要在`onStart`回调函数中创建process

satisfaction_conditions: A correct approach to create and manage processes in Swoole that allows pushing messages to WebSocket clients
Proper integration between Swoole processes and the WebSocket server's connection management
A solution that maintains proper access to the server object across different Swoole components

_classification.category: Can be dockerized without any issue

dockerfile:
FROM php:5.6-cli

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /usr/src/app

# Update to use archive.debian.org for Debian Stretch packages
RUN sed -i 's/deb.debian.org/archive.debian.org/g' /etc/apt/sources.list \
    && sed -i 's/security.debian.org/archive.debian.org/g' /etc/apt/sources.list \
    && sed -i '/stretch-updates/d' /etc/apt/sources.list

# Install dependencies for building Swoole
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    git \
    unzip \
    libssl-dev \
    libcurl4-openssl-dev \
    make \
    autoconf \
    g++ \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Clone the repository at the specific commit related to the issue
RUN git clone https://github.com/swoole/swoole-src.git . \
    && git checkout ce52d05850928ab47a403e17506503003396b5c2

# Build and install Swoole
RUN phpize \
    && ./configure \
    && make -j$(nproc) \
    && make install

# Enable Swoole extension
RUN docker-php-ext-enable swoole

# Create a test file that demonstrates the issue
RUN echo '<?php\n\
$server = new \\swoole_websocket_server("0.0.0.0", 9443);\n\
\n\
$server->set(array(\n\
    "worker_num" => 1,\n\
    "max_request" => 500,\n\
    "task_worker_num" => 1,\n\
    "max_connection" => 1024\n\
));\n\
\n\
$server->on("start", function (\\swoole_websocket_server $server) {\n\
    $pid = getmypid();\n\
    $mPid = getmypid();\n\
    echo "this is Master pid: $mPid\\n";\n\
    \n\
    $process = new swoole_process("process");\n\
    $pid = $process->start();\n\
});\n\
\n\
$server->on("message", function (\\swoole_websocket_server $server, $frame) {\n\
    echo "receive from {$frame->fd}:{$frame->data},opcode:{$frame->opcode},fin:{$frame->finish} workerid: {$server->worker_id}\\n";\n\
});\n\
\n\
$server->on("task", function (\\swoole_server $serv, $task_id, $from_id, $data) {});\n\
$server->on("finish", function (\\swoole_server $serv, $task_id, $from_id, $data) {});\n\
\n\
function process(swoole_process $process)\n\
{\n\
    global $server;\n\
    swoole_set_process_name("php processor");\n\
    // Wait for client connection, send data to client in a loop after 20 seconds\n\
    swoole_timer_after(20 * 1000, function() use ($server){\n\
        foreach ($server->connections as $fd) {\n\
            var_dump($fd);\n\
            $server->push($fd, "hello");\n\
        }\n\
    });\n\
}\n\
\n\
// Uncomment to run: $server->start();\n\
echo "Swoole is installed. You can run the test file to verify the issue.\\n";\n\
' > test_issue_912.php

# Set the default command to check PHP modules
CMD ["php", "-m"]
